reviews.title: Black screen after only 5 months of regular use
reviews.comment:
3070TI started causing black screen issues every 10 minutes after only 5 months of normal everyday use with light gaming. Took all the necessary troubleshooting steps and nothing worked. Went to submit a repair request and the product apparently is out of warranty after less than 6 months of ownership. Garbage. Company a
I recommend avoiding purchasing from this company as their "renewed" products don't undergo thorough testing.
